Global Central Banks May Hike Rates Amid Inflation Concerns

Several central banks globally are considering further interest rate hikes due to persistent inflation. In the United States, a pickup in job growth may prompt the Federal Reserve to increase rates again. Similarly, Australia's Reserve Bank is tipped to hike rates as inflation remains stubborn. Meanwhile, growth is playing a key supporting role in the Bank of Canada's decision regarding a potential rate hike.
